Package com.kristensoft.kdc

Class Client

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.kristensoft.kdc.Client
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Closeable, AutoCloseable, Runnable
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    KristenHttpClient, MulticastClient, TcpClient, UdpClient
    public abstract class Client
extends Object
implements Runnable, Closeable
    Abstract base class that provides common functionality for KDC client implementations. Clients provide the communication interface used to send agents and internally process agents received using a specific protocol.

    Applications may access a client through an Agent, but client implementations are created and managed by KDC.

    A client may receive multiple Reply objects in response to sent agents. Replies are retained in a reply queue and may be accessed using nextReply(), peekReply(), pollReply(), and replyAvailable().

    Author:
    Charles B. Kozoyed
    See Also:
    CommsEntity, TcpClient, UdpClient, MulticastClient, KristenHttpClient

      • pollReply

        public Reply pollReply​(long timeout,
                       TimeUnit timeUnit)
                throws InterruptedException
        Waits up to the specified timeout for a reply and removes it from this client's reply queue.

        If a reply is already available, this method returns immediately. Otherwise, it waits until a reply becomes available, the timeout expires, or the calling thread is interrupted. A timeout does not indicate that the server has finished sending replies.

        Example: 

        
 try {
     client.sendAsync(agent);

     while (true) {
 
         Reply reply = client.pollReply(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
 
         if (reply == null) {
             // No reply yet; continue waiting.
             continue;
         }

         processReply(reply);

         if (reply.isLastReply()) {
             break;
         }
     }
 } catch (InterruptedException e) {
     Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
 }
        Parameters:
        timeout - the maximum time to wait; a value less than or equal to zero causes this method to return without waiting
        timeUnit - the time unit of the timeout
        Returns:
        the next reply removed from the queue, or null if the timeout expires before a reply becomes available
        Throws:
        InterruptedException - if the calling thread is interrupted while waiting
        NullPointerException - if timeUnit is null
        See Also:
        pollReply(), takeReply()

      • takeReply

        public Reply takeReply()
                throws InterruptedException
        Waits for and removes the next reply from this client's reply queue. Blocks until a reply becomes available or the calling thread is interrupted. This method has no timeout.

        Replies are received independently of this method and remain queued until consumed. An empty queue does not indicate that the server has finished sending replies.

        For a sequence of replies, the caller can continue taking replies until the server marks a reply as the last reply. The final reply should also be processed.

        Example: 

        
 try {

     client.sendAsync(agent);
     Reply reply;

     do {

         reply = client.takeReply();
         processReply(reply);

     } while (!reply.isLastReply());

 } catch (InterruptedException e) {
     Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
 }

        Run this code on a background thread when the calling thread must remain responsive.

        Returns:
        the next reply removed from the queue
        Throws:
        InterruptedException - if the calling thread is interrupted while waiting
        See Also:
        pollReply()
